name: fix75_drop_flat
verifies: fix-75 #1: a downed fighter's weapon lies flat on the ground (G3: DropItemsFromSlot at the hand matrix, the item's rigid body settles on its widest side), not upright stuck in the ground: its long mesh axis within 20 deg of the ground plane, its lowest point -3..+10 cm from the ground
steps: spawn Orc_Elite_01 attitude=neutral dist=4 side=left as=orc
notes: The fight op lowers the NPC's HP and melees it down; DropHandItems drops its drawn weapon as a world item (CombatPresenter.Drop -> WorldItems.Drop -> WorldItemViews -> WorldItemRest). dropprobe logs per item: long axis angle to the ground, up axis angle to the normal, gap. Before fix-75 the sword stood upright (long axis ~90 deg). fix-184 (regress-1021b: Kent went down at the first swing, 0.7 s, his sword still sheathed, so nothing dropped): each victim is turned on the hero and has its weapon drawn before the fight.
